## Public feedback

GitHub Issues and Discussions are disabled on this fork. Public feedback PRs
must add a redacted Markdown file at `docs/feedback/<topic>.md`; use the
[feedback template](../docs/feedback/README.md). Do not include passwords,
tokens, or raw health data. Open the PR against
[`Jasper-1024/home-assistant-garmin_connect`](https://github.com/Jasper-1024/home-assistant-garmin_connect/pulls)
from a branch on your fork.

- [ ] This PR adds the required redacted `docs/feedback/<topic>.md` file.

Describe the bug, request, or other feedback in that file.
